evals.name: bootstrap-react-project
evals.description: Generate a tailored Copilot harness for a React/TypeScript/Vite project with Jest, Prettier, and Vercel deployment
evals.prompt: I just cloned a React project. It uses TypeScript, Vite for bundling, Jest for testing, Prettier for formatting, and deploys to Vercel. Set up Copilot for this project.
assertions: Creates .github/copilot-instructions.md with stack-specific content (not generic)
copilot-instructions.md includes build/test/lint commands for npm/vite/jest/prettier
Creates at least one conditional .instructions.md file (e.g., react.instructions.md with applyTo: '**/*.tsx')
copilot-instructions.md is under 400 lines
Creates .github/memory/ directory with MEMORY.md
Creates at least one hook definition in .github/hooks/
Creates or references at least one agent in .github/agents/
Mentions Vercel deployment in instructions or memory

evals.name: diagnose-broken-harness
evals.description: Audit a Copilot harness that has bloated instructions, no conditional files, no memory, no agents, and over-permissive hooks
evals.prompt: Audit my Copilot setup. My copilot-instructions.md is 800 lines, I have no conditional instruction files, no memory system, no custom agents, and my hooks don't have any PreToolUse gates.
assertions: Identifies context engineering problem (instructions >600 lines)
Flags missing conditional instruction files (progressive disclosure)
Identifies missing memory system (persistence gap)
Identifies missing agents (no orchestration/routing)
Identifies missing PreToolUse hooks (permission/safety gap)
Uses the 7-pillar framework to structure the assessment
Produces a maturity score (should be low, 2-5 range)
Recommends specific improvements in priority order

evals.name: create-python-hooks
evals.description: Add a ruff lint hook and a secret scanner hook for a Python project
evals.prompt: I have a Python project that uses ruff for linting. Add a PostToolUse hook that runs ruff after every edit, and a PreToolUse hook that blocks writes containing secrets.
assertions: Creates a PostToolUse hook JSON definition in .github/hooks/
Creates a companion shell script for ruff linting
Script correctly reads JSON from stdin and extracts tool_name/tool_input
Script only runs ruff on .py files
Script exits 0 (doesn't block on lint issues, reports them)
Creates a PreToolUse hook JSON definition for secret scanning
Secret scanner script returns permissionDecision: deny when secrets found
Secret scanner script exits 0 for clean files
Both scripts are made executable
